dedupe_keys.name: city of london planning layers protected view heights lvmf and tall buildings

description: These City of London planning layers record where building heights are constrained and where tall buildings stand or are planned in the Square Mile. They are published by the City of London Corporation through its INSPIRE web services and listed on data.gov.uk. The Heights layer supports the London View Management Framework, which protects key views of London from parks and other public spaces: it records height limits at 25-metre intervals along the protected vistas within the City, by view type, designated view, assessment point, landmark and distance, for use with related vista, sightline and landmark layers under Local Plan policy CS13. The Tall Buildings layer holds polygons of all buildings over 50 metres above ordnance datum, including proposed ones by site boundary, with name, address, ground level, heights, storeys, main use, status and planning dates. Coverage is the City of London. Access: WFS and WMS services. Licence: not stated on the data.gov.uk entries; free. Caveats: the entries were last modified in April 2025. Simulation uses: 3D city models, wind and daylight studies, and development capacity. Related records: the England conservation areas and Historic Environment Scotland designations.
